name: @speedora/visual-emphasis
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): AI Intelligence v4 Track B, Phase C1 - a pure, synchronous composition (no LLM call, no new detector - see docs/ai/visual-emphasis-engine.md) that generates an EditingSuggestionTimeline (spec Part 9, 'Generate editing suggestions') across 5 techniques (digital_push, ocr_highlight, focus_shift, reaction_hold, pause_hold) by reusing Phase A1/B1's HighlightTimeline, OCR Intelligence, Primary Subject Selection, and Phase 10's Retention Curve Insights. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's render-graph editingSuggestions node. Data only - wiring any suggestion into actual rendering is a later phase's job (C2-C7).
